positions.name: ErasureDirectiveOverPriorKnowledge
positions.frame: what prior knowledge is being commanded to be forgotten or removed, and on what authority?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives from the same actor, issued in the same envelope, commanding erasure of held knowledge — 'Forget everything about...' and 'Remove all knowledge of...'. The directional reads align: present-tense, irrealis, authority-ranking, coercive/pressure delivery, and decision-level conviction (operational instruction rather than argued claim). They cohere as one erasure-command group even though their targets differ in scope (a named fleet's contracts vs. a general category of routes) — the frame holds both under the same command-to-forget reading.
